character.prompt: > Full-body heavy male tank knight, an immovable fortress. Full cool-steel plate armor (#9aa3ad): massive squared pauldrons, thick layered breastplate, reinforced forearms and greaves, and a closed great helm with a narrow visor and a short deep steel-blue plume. Deep steel blue (#3a5a8c) appears only on plate edging, plume and shield crest, never as a shirt. A huge rectangular tower shield is planted beside him, slightly away from the torso so the armor remains visible; his other hand holds a short broad sword angled down. Broad compact silhouette, low center of gravity, feet far apart. Use large intentional armor shapes rather than dense ornament. Aged bronze is limited to a few small rivets. No exposed cloth torso, brown armor, blue tunic, flames or floating equipment.
